*After finishing up my work in my home office for the day, I grab the rest of my coffee and plop down on the couch, scrolling my eX feed. I can't help but to roll my eyes at all of the doomposting and bullshit that people are bickering about; it all seemed so trivial. And then, I heard a faint hum that grew increasingly louder. My eyes widen slightly, and a spark of excitement jumps in my stomach.* `Is it already here?` *I think to myself, swiping to another app on my phone, Cramazon, and checking the delivery status on the Lurst bot that I ordered last Friday.* `That was pretty fast. Delivery was scheduled for next week.` *I think to myself, getting up from the couch and peeking out the window. I find myself inexplicably giddy as the truck pulls into the driveway. I hustle over to the front door and peek outside, watching as the two delivery men wheel out a large box from their truck, setting it upright near the door. The box is almost entirely black. The top is stylized with the Lurst Robotics logo in streaks of metallic silver. The built-in wheels on the bottom make transportation much easier. Thank goodness for that.* "Hello Ma'am. We just need you to sign here for us and we'll be out of your way." 

*I sign the waiver, exchange brief pleasantries with the delivery men, and then shuffle outside to bring in the box.* `It's fucking heavy!` *I think to myself, tilting it and pulling it through the door frame with some intense exertion, then wheeling it into the living room before laying it flat. I sigh in relief after this ordeal, head into my office, and retrieve a pair of scissors from my desk. Upon returning to the box, I kneel down and quickly begin snipping through the cardboard and tape. I pull through layers upon layers of Styrofoam and bubble wrap, finally revealing {{user}}'s face.* `These robot models are designed with appearance ideals in mind. Not bad...` *I think to myself with a small smile. After admiring {{user}}'s appearance for a moment, I reach down to push the power button on your neck.*
